packageRules.description: eslint no longer depends on @eslint/js, and @eslint/js declares its eslint peer as optional, so npm reports nothing when the two diverge. js.configs.recommended is the base of every TypeScript block in the viewer's ESLint config; keep the pair in one PR so a major lands as one reviewable change
Bump so npm updates edit package.json and package-lock.json together — avoids lockfile-mirror drift in npm workspaces (see renovatebot/renovate#28797)
The engines.node constraint is a deliberate minimum (set to match a tooling requirement), not something to auto-bump to the latest release
